expected_response.expected_effect: No change to the executing pointcloud scalar or its parameters; the incumbent program D2_without_trajectory_static continues with pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, teacher_neighbors 4, mixture_temperature 0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0 unchanged.
expected_response.primary_objective: Final predicted target affinity remains the primary criterion; no registered edit has a defensible expected advantage on the supplied evidence.

failure_modes: A pair-kernel or shape-moment edit is not available in the registered edit set; attempting to steer those diagnostics through pointcloud_delta_A would be an unregistered mechanism.
Treating joint_innovation_RMS_A or joint_internal_RMS_A as a coordinate reward target would misread a joint-motion diagnostic as a force the executing scalar does not contain.

A time-conditioned regional attention edit could overfit low-fidelity curves; curve_support retained only 24 of the candidate curves and most audited landmark-00/02/03/04/05/06 features have relative_node_rmse 0.58-0.67 with strong sign conflicts.
Reading survival_enrichment_z as final affinity benefit would overstate recorded joint-head credit while decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable.
Reading turnover_residual_rate as within-path coordinate change would confuse cohort composition and score reclassification with trajectory change.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest and most reproducible endpoint contrasts are on short-range pair kernels (endpoint_effects:9/10/11, positive_batch_fraction 1.0) and on global shape_yy/shape_xx (endpoint_effects:3/4), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). The only registered coordinate knobs are pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend; none of them is a pair-kernel or shape-moment control, so no permitted edit is connected to the Analyst's leading hypotheses. The joint-motion signals (branch_adjusted:74/76/151/153/228/230/305/307) are diagnostics, not coordinate reward targets, and joint_diagnostics:2 shows innovation is negatively associated with observed child score gain, so treating lower innovation as a favorable force would be unsupported. The temporal evidence (continuous:0-9, continuous_functions) is observed-node linear contrast over [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation and curve_support retains only 24 of the candidate curves (relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0), so a time-conditioned regional attention edit is not defensibly better than the constant rule. Increment contrasts disagree with population contrasts (increment_effects:14/15 vs endpoint_effects:14/15; increment_effects:3/4 negative), survival credit is recorded joint-head credit with decoded terminal labels unavailable (survival_effects:0/23/46/70/100/186/249; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available), and turnover residuals are composition/accounting diagnostics (turnover:1/2/14/17/47/134/224/227/254/257/497/524/584/587). With affinity primary and no evidence-backed expected advantage for any registered bounded edit, retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice; the fixed temperatures (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) are immutable and are not proposed for change.
